facts.fact: The Secretary General of the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Mobility reported, at the SNEC steering committee of 25 June 2026, that in 2025 the software for systematic declaration of civil-status events was deployed in 30 main centres and 140 secondary centres; no total number of centres is given.

The SNEC steering committee is chaired by the Secretary General of the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Mobility, and the Director General for the Modernisation of Civil Status reported on 25 June 2026 the progressive deployment of VENEEM in communes.

The Stratégie nationale de l'état civil (SNEC) 2023-2027 aims at a modern, secure and fully digitalised civil-status system by 2027, and the Director General for the Modernisation of Civil Status cited the deployment of VENEEM as an advance under it on 25 June 2026.

The ministry reported for 2025 a financing rate of 54.03%, financial execution of 81.83% and physical execution of 45.55% for the SNEC, and named insufficient financing of the action plan as a constraint; the source of the funds is not stated.

The ministry's 2025 results, validated on 25 June 2026, record deployment of the declaration software in 30 main and 140 secondary centres during 2025, and the Director General said on that date that deployment of VENEEM in communes was continuing.
